Windows · Free and open source

Codex limits in the Windows system tray

See what’s left of your five-hour and weekly Codex limits and when they reset. Keep the indicator next to the clock or open a small always-on-top widget.

Download for Windows ↓ Portable ZIP and other releases

Windows x64 installer · Requires Codex installed and signed in

Setup

How to show Codex limits in the tray

  1. Sign in to Codex. Use Codex Desktop or run codex login. The tray app needs no separate account or API key.
  2. Run the Windows installer. It installs for your Windows account without admin rights. The installer is unsigned, so SmartScreen may show a warning. Download it only from this project’s GitHub Releases.
  3. Open Codex Limit Tray. Close the window to keep the app running in the tray. Click the icon to see what’s left and when your limits reset.

Can’t see the tray icon?

Open the hidden-icons menu (↑) and drag the icon next to the clock. To start the app with Windows, enable Appearance → Start at login.

Codex Limit Tray is independent and not affiliated with OpenAI. It shows Codex subscription limits, not general ChatGPT limits or API spending.
